result.title: About Us - ER of White Rock
result.content:
About ER of White Rock

At ER of White Rock, we are more than just a local clinic. We are your trusted partner in emergency medical care, dedicated to serving the Dallas, TX, community with compassion, expertise, and minimal wait times. Our mission is simple: to deliver high-quality, board-certified emergency treatment when you need it most. We are open and ready to help you 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

Our Commitment to Excellence

When a medical crisis strikes, time is your most valuable asset. Our facility is staffed by a dedicated team of board-certified doctors and experienced nurses who are fully prepared to treat severe health issues. We provide immediate medical intervention for everything from painful fractures to complex, life-threatening traumas.
  • Fast Medical Attention: Get evaluated and treated by a physician right away.
  • Complete Patient Care: Expert solutions for both children and adults.
  • Minimal Wait Times: We prioritize your health so you never have to sit in a crowded lobby.
  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: We utilize on-site digital imaging and lab diagnostics.
  • Compassionate Staff: Experience a calm, private, and supportive healing environment.
  • Always Open: Our emergency room is ready to serve you every hour of the year.
By pairing modern diagnostic tools with a medical team that truly cares about your recovery, we deliver precise answers and fast relief. You receive premium emergency treatment exactly when you need it. Call Now For Emergency Care

A Culture of Compassion

We understand that emergencies are stressful. From the moment you walk through our doors, our team prioritizes not only your physical health but also your emotional well-being. Everyone is treated with personalized attention.  

Accreditation & Safety

ER of White Rock meets the highest standards of emergency care. Our facility adheres to strict safety protocols, and our team undergoes continuous training to stay ahead of medical advancements. Your health and safety are our top priorities.

Why Choose ER of White Rock?

When a health crisis happens, you need immediate answers. Our Dallas emergency center is designed from the ground up to get you fast, effective medical attention when it matters most. We prioritize your health by ensuring you are evaluated by a physician with minimal wait times, day or night.
  • Always Open: Medical emergencies do not stick to business hours. We are fully staffed and ready to treat you 24 hours a day, every day of the year.
  • Expert Medical Staff: Your health is in the hands of seasoned doctors and registered nurses who specialize in severe trauma and critical illness.
  • Advanced Diagnostics: We utilize modern on-site imaging and laboratory testing to figure out exactly what is wrong in minutes instead of hours.
  • Dedicated to Dallas: We are a proud neighborhood facility committed to keeping local families, individuals, and visitors safe and healthy.

Our Patient-Centered Approach

At ER of White Rock, we understand that a medical crisis is incredibly stressful. That is why our emergency care focuses on treating you with respect, clear communication, and minimal wait times. From the second you walk through our doors, our medical staff works quickly to ensure you feel supported and safe. You are a valued member of our local community, and your rapid recovery is our absolute priority. Book an Emergency Appointment

tabs.tab_title: ¿Atienden a Richardson?
tabs.tab_content: Sí. Las familias de Richardson llegan a ER of White Rock manejando al sur por Plano Road o Jupiter Road a través de Lake Highlands. Estamos en 10705 Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238, abiertos 24/7 sin cita. Llame al (469) 943-2939 en camino si gusta.

tabs.tab_title: ¿Qué hago si la situación pone en riesgo la vida?
tabs.tab_content: Llame al 911 primero. Ante un colapso, un sangrado mayor o señales de derrame, los paramédicos inician la atención de inmediato y eligen el centro apropiado más cercano. No gaste minutos extra manejando. Para problemas serios pero estables, venga directo a cualquier hora.

tabs.tab_title: ¿Cuándo necesita un dolor de garganta o una tos ir a emergencias?
tabs.tab_content: Venga cuando tragar o respirar se vuelva difícil, la fiebre no baje, o los síntomas empeoren rápido a pesar del cuidado en casa. El Colegio Americano de Médicos de Emergencia ofrece su guía Know When to Go (en inglés). Los síntomas leves caben en urgent care o con su doctor.

tabs.tab_title: ¿Funciona mi seguro aquí?
tabs.tab_content: Aceptamos la mayoría de los planes privados principales. Por ley federal, cada paciente recibe un examen médico de evaluación sin importar su capacidad de pago. Como sala de emergencias independiente, no participamos en Medicare ni Medicaid, y revisamos los costos con usted antes del alta.

tabs.tab_title: ¿Necesito referencia o cita?
tabs.tab_content: No. La atención de emergencia es sin cita, de día y de noche, incluidos fines de semana y feriados. Venga directo a 10705 Northwest Hwy cuando un problema no pueda esperar. Más información de salud en español en MedlinePlus en español.

settings.editor: ER of White Rock treats Richardson patients every hour of the year. Our freestanding emergency room is at 10705 Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238, a straight drive south on Plano Road through Lake Highlands. Walk in any time. No appointment needed.

From cardiac emergencies to winter illness, everything below is diagnosed and treated on site with CT, digital X-ray, ultrasound and a rapid lab. When severe respiratory symptoms spike each season, MedlinePlus flu guidance explains when they turn serious. Tap a card for details.

settings.description_text: EKG and cardiac labs start within minutes of arrival.
BE-FAST screening and immediate CT, plus rapid transfer coordination.
Head hits from sports or falls checked with neuro exams and imaging.
Throat pain with fever or swallowing trouble tested and treated on site.
Severe vomiting, GI bleeding and dehydration evaluated with labs and imaging.
Chest X-ray, breathing support and treatment for stubborn respiratory infections.

settings.editor: Median door-to-provider time is under 10 minutes, every visit. Four steps from door to answers.
Open 24 hours a day, every day of the year. No referral, no appointment.
A clinician checks your symptoms and vital signs within minutes.
CT, digital X-ray, ultrasound and lab work run in-house, with most lab results back in 10 to 20 minutes.
Most patients are treated and home the same day. If you need admission, we arrange the hospital transfer.

tabs.tab_title: Do you serve Richardson?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Richardson families reach ER of White Rock by driving south on Plano Road or Jupiter Road through Lake Highlands. We are at 10705 Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238, open 24/7 with walk-in care. Call (469) 943-2939 on the way if you like.

tabs.tab_title: What if the situation is life-threatening?
tabs.tab_content: Call 911 first. For collapse, major bleeding, or stroke signs, paramedics start care immediately and choose the closest appropriate facility. Do not spend extra minutes driving. For serious but stable problems, come straight in at any hour.

tabs.tab_title: When does a sore throat or cough need an ER?
tabs.tab_content: Come in when swallowing or breathing becomes difficult, fever stays high, or symptoms worsen fast despite home care. The American College of Emergency Physicians offers Know When to Go guidance for judging severity. Mild symptoms usually fit urgent care or your doctor.

tabs.tab_title: Will my insurance work here?
tabs.tab_content: We accept most major private insurance plans. By federal law, every patient gets a medical screening exam regardless of ability to pay. As a freestanding emergency room, we do not participate in Medicare or Medicaid, and our team reviews costs with you before discharge.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need a referral or appointment?
tabs.tab_content: No. Emergency care is walk-in only, day and night. Come directly to 10705 Northwest Hwy whenever a medical problem cannot wait, weekends and holidays included. The full emergency team, imaging and lab run around the clock.

settings.editor: Three straightforward routes south.
Take Plano Road south through Lake Highlands until it meets Northwest Highway, then continue to 10705 Northwest Hwy.
Follow Jupiter Road south to Northwest Highway, then head west toward White Rock Lake.
Take Central Expressway south to LBJ Freeway, head east, exit at Skillman Street, and follow Skillman south to Northwest Highway.

settings.title: Preguntas Sobre Emergencias en Forest Hills

tabs.tab_title: ¿Hay una sala de emergencias cerca de Forest Hills y el Dallas Arboretum?
tabs.tab_content: Sí. ER of White Rock está en 10705 Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238, al norte del lago White Rock. Desde Forest Hills, tome Garland Road al noreste hasta Buckner Boulevard y siga al norte por el lago hasta Northwest Highway. Abrimos 24/7.

tabs.tab_title: Me lastimé en el sendero del lago White Rock. ¿A dónde voy?
tabs.tab_content: Para caídas, posibles fracturas, golpes en la cabeza o heridas que puedan necesitar puntos, venga directo a nuestra sala de emergencias. Los rayos X y la tomografía se hacen en el sitio, así que recibe respuestas en la misma visita. Si la lesión parece poner en riesgo la vida, llame al 911 desde el sendero.

tabs.tab_title: ¿Tratan el agotamiento por calor y la deshidratación?
tabs.tab_content: Sí. Corredores y ciclistas del circuito del lago llegan con enfermedades por calor cada verano. Las tratamos con líquidos intravenosos, corrección de electrolitos y monitoreo. La confusión, el desmayo o una temperatura que no baja es una emergencia. Lea más en MedlinePlus en español o venga de inmediato.

tabs.tab_title: ¿Qué seguros aceptan?
tabs.tab_content: La mayoría de los planes privados principales, incluidos BCBS, Aetna, Cigna y UnitedHealthcare. Cada paciente recibe un examen médico de evaluación sin importar su capacidad de pago, como exige la ley federal. Las salas de emergencias independientes no participan en Medicare ni Medicaid, y revisamos los costos con usted antes del alta.

tabs.tab_title: ¿Cuándo elijo la sala de emergencias en vez del urgent care?
tabs.tab_content: Los síntomas severos o repentinos van a una sala de emergencias: dolor de pecho, señales de derrame, dificultad para respirar, cortadas profundas, posibles fracturas. La tos leve o un esguince menor caben en urgent care. El Colegio Americano de Médicos de Emergencia lo explica en Know When to Go (en inglés). Ante la duda, llame al 911.

tabs.tab_title: ¿Debo ir a una sala de emergencias o a urgent care?

settings.editor: ER of White Rock welcomes Mesquite patients around the clock. Our freestanding emergency room is at 10705 Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238, an easy drive from Mesquite via LBJ Freeway and Northwest Highway. Walk in any hour. No appointment needed.

Our emergency team diagnoses and treats the conditions below on site, with CT, digital X-ray, ultrasound and a rapid lab under one roof. Abdominal pain alone accounts for roughly 1 in 11 US emergency visits, according to the CDC. Tap a card to see how each one is handled.

settings.description_text: Immediate EKG and cardiac workup, day or night.

Chemical splashes, foreign objects and eye trauma treated by our ER team.
Severe or sudden back pain evaluated with imaging when red flags appear.

settings.editor: Median door-to-provider time is under 10 minutes, every visit. A typical visit looks like this.

tabs.tab_title: Do you treat patients from Mesquite?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Families across Mesquite use ER of White Rock for 24/7 emergency care. We are at 10705 Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238. Take LBJ Freeway north to the Northwest Highway exit, or call (469) 943-2939 on the way in.

tabs.tab_title: What if the emergency is life-threatening?
tabs.tab_content: Call 911 first. For symptoms like collapse, major bleeding, or stroke signs, paramedics can begin treatment immediately and take you to the closest appropriate facility. Never spend extra time driving when minutes matter. For serious but stable emergencies, walk into our ER any hour.

tabs.tab_title: How is a freestanding ER different from urgent care?
tabs.tab_content: A freestanding ER is a full emergency room: CT scanning, on-site labs, monitored beds and emergency clinicians around the clock. Urgent care handles minor illness and small injuries during business hours. The American College of Emergency Physicians explains the difference in its Know When to Go resources.

tabs.tab_title: Will my insurance cover the visit?
tabs.tab_content: We work with most major private insurance plans. Every patient receives a medical screening exam regardless of ability to pay, as federal law requires. Note that freestanding emergency rooms do not participate in Medicare or Medicaid. Our staff walks you through costs before discharge.

tabs.tab_title: Can I walk in at 3 a.m.?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. The emergency room is staffed and fully operational 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Overnight visits get the same clinicians, imaging and lab capability as daytime visits. Come straight in whenever the problem cannot wait until morning.

settings.title: Serving Forest Hills and East Dallas
24/7 Emergency Room Near Forest Hills, Dallas

settings.editor: Forest Hills sits along the southeast shore of White Rock Lake, and ER of White Rock is a short drive north at 10705 Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238. Our emergency room is open 24 hours a day. Walk in whenever you need care.

settings.title: What Can We Treat Near Forest Hills?

settings.editor: Everything from cardiac emergencies to trail injuries is handled on site. Our emergency team runs CT, digital X-ray, ultrasound and a full lab under one roof, so diagnosis and treatment happen in the same visit. Tap a card below to see how we treat each condition.

settings.description_text: EKG and cardiac testing the moment you arrive.
BE-FAST screening and immediate CT, with transfer to a stroke center when needed.
Cycling falls and hard hits checked with neuro exams and CT imaging.
Digital X-ray, splinting and casting for falls on and off the trail.
IV fluids and electrolyte care after long runs or hot Texas afternoons.
Fevers, injuries and breathing trouble in children, treated any hour.

settings.editor: Median door-to-provider time is under 10 minutes, every visit. From arrival to answers, here is the path.
Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. No appointment or referral needed.
A clinician evaluates your symptoms and vitals within minutes of check-in.
CT, X-ray, ultrasound and labs run in-house. Most lab results come back in 10 to 20 minutes.
Most emergencies resolve on site. When hospital admission is needed, we coordinate the transfer for you.

tabs.tab_title: Is there an ER near Forest Hills and the Dallas Arboretum?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. ER of White Rock is at 10705 Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238, north of White Rock Lake. From Forest Hills, take Garland Road northeast to Buckner Boulevard, then follow Buckner north along the lake to Northwest Highway. We are open 24/7.

tabs.tab_title: I got hurt on the White Rock Lake trail. Where should I go?
tabs.tab_content: For falls, suspected fractures, head hits, or wounds that may need stitches, come straight to our emergency room. X-ray and CT run on site, so you get answers the same visit. If an injury looks life-threatening, call 911 from the trail instead of driving.

tabs.tab_title: Do you treat heat exhaustion and dehydration?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Runners and cyclists from the lake loop come in with heat illness every summer. We treat it with IV fluids, electrolyte correction and lab monitoring. Confusion, fainting, or a body temperature that stays high is an emergency. Come in immediately or call 911.

tabs.tab_title: Which insurance plans do you accept?
tabs.tab_content: Most major private plans, including BCBS, Aetna, Cigna and UnitedHealthcare. Every patient receives a medical screening exam regardless of ability to pay, as federal law requires. Freestanding emergency rooms do not participate in Medicare or Medicaid, and our team reviews costs with you before discharge.

tabs.tab_title: When should I choose the ER over urgent care?
tabs.tab_content: Severe or sudden symptoms belong in an ER: chest pain, stroke signs, trouble breathing, deep cuts, possible broken bones. Minor coughs and sprains fit urgent care. The American College of Emergency Physicians explains more in its Know When to Go guide. In doubt, call 911.
